reason: The beans need to be gathered before they can be cooked; the lined basket is intended for harvesting.
expectation: The basket will collect the dry soybean pods.

effect: The soybean pods are gathered and ready for preparation.
reaction: The harvest connects the meal to the row that survived the storm.
reason: The beans need thorough cooking, so I'll try putting the gathered pods with the cooker.
expectation: The beans will be prepared for cooking in the pot, possibly with water.

effect: The pods had to be opened with clean fabric first; the dry soybeans are now ready for cooking.
reaction: The compatibility feedback clarified the missing preparation step.
reason: The shelled beans need thorough cooking in the solar pot.
expectation: The beans will be cooked in the pot, potentially using the available drinking water.

effect: The beans needed soaking before cooking; they are now drained and rinsed.
reaction: The feedback revealed another preparation step I had missed.
reason: The soaked beans and ready cooking vessel now appear to be the next pair.
expectation: The beans will cook thoroughly in the pot.

effect: The beans are thoroughly cooked, and the goal now calls for potatoes and lettuce alongside them.
reaction: The separate bean-cooking step makes the food preparation feel purposeful.
reason: The potatoes must be harvested before they can go into the stew, and the lined basket is suited to the job.
expectation: The basket will collect potatoes from the bed.

effect: The potatoes have been harvested, washed and cut, so they are ready to add to the cooked beans.
reaction: The substantial harvest makes the earlier planting feel worthwhile.
reason: The prepared potatoes can now join the cooked beans for the stew.
expectation: The potatoes will cook with the beans to make stew.

effect: The potatoes and beans are cooked into stew; fresh lettuce remains to be gathered.
reaction: The second heating makes the cooking sequence clear.
reason: The lined basket can collect the fresh lettuce for the meal, as it did in the earlier harvest.
expectation: The basket will collect fresh lettuce leaves.

effect: The lettuce is harvested and washed, ready to serve with the stew.
reaction: Leaving the centre growing is a nice practical detail.
reason: Both components of the meal are ready to serve together.
expectation: The lettuce and stew will make the finished meal.

effect: The lettuce and stew became a finished supper, completing the chapter’s goals.
reaction: The contrast of crisp leaves and warm stew made the harvest feel like a satisfying payoff.

mostWorthwhile.text: Cooking the beans separately before adding potatoes made the meal feel physically sensible, and harvesting the potatoes paid off the earlier growing work.

leastWorthwhile.text: My repeated attempts to use the pot before shelling and soaking the beans were slightly repetitive, though the compatibility feedback kept them moving.

surprise.text: I expected to cook the gathered pods directly; the feedback instead revealed separate shelling and soaking steps.

arbitrary.text: Using clean fabric to catch the shelled beans was less obvious to me than the cooking steps, but its purpose was clear once shown.

continue.text: Yes. The practical food preparation and the payoff of eating crops kept alive through the storm make me curious to see how the expedition concludes.
